name: Vasili Achampong-Skobelev
location: The Underworld - B4-B8, near sub-level access near Dearborn and Jackson
description: Vasili commands the Graycloaks. Enormous, unaugmented by choice, carries a salvaged riot shield he has never had to use.

physical_description.build: Massive and lean — a wall of muscle gone slightly soft with age, broad-shouldered and dense. Prison-yard bulk, not gym-built. Forearms thick as fence posts.
physical_description.hair_style: Cropped military flat-top, receding at temples
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep brown with ashy undertones, weathered to leather
physical_description.complexion: Deep facial creases around the eyes and mouth. Strong jaw, prominent cheekbones. Stubble perpetually at 2-day growth. Pores enlarged from decades of grime and sweat in sub-levels.
distinguishing_marks: Faded Cyrillic prison tattoo on left forearm: three stacked lines (sentence marker from pre-Collapse era)
Burn scar across the back of right hand — white and puckered, shaped like a handprint
Long thin scar running from left cheekbone to jawline, pale and old
Knuckle scars across both hands — fighter's hands, bone-white ridges
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. Deliberately unaugmented — a statement of power in a chrome-heavy world.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight balanced, feet shoulder-width apart — ready to move. Moves slowly and deliberately, each motion economical. Doesn't swagger. Presence fills a room without effort.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian. Worn olive drab cargo jacket, patched at elbows and shoulders. Black reinforced trousers with cargo pockets. Steel-toed boots, laced tight. A salvaged riot shield slung across his back — dented, marked with gang tags he refuses to remove. No corpo logos. Wears a faded gray undershirt beneath the jacket, collar always visible and worn soft.
